        raise SchemeError("set! requires a symbol")
    expr = rest.cdr.car
    val = eval_form(expr, env, tail=False)
    env.set(name.name, val)
    return UNSPECIFIED

def _eval_begin(form, env, tail):
    # (begin e1 e2 ...)
    rest = form.cdr
    if rest is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed begin: empty")
    forms = list_to_pylist(rest)
    for i, f in enumerate(forms[:-1]):
        eval_form(f, env, tail=False)
    return eval_form(forms[-1], env, tail=tail)

def _eval_cond(form, env, tail):
    # (cond clause...)
    rest = form.cdr
    if rest is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed cond: no clauses")
    clauses = list_to_pylist(rest)
    for i, clause in enumerate(clauses):
        if not isinstance(clause, SchemePair) or not is_proper_list(clause):
            raise SchemeError("malformed cond clause")
        if clause.cdr is SCHEME_EMPTY:
            raise SchemeError("malformed cond clause")
        test = clause.car
        body = clause.cdr
        is_last = (i == len(clauses) - 1)
        
        if isinstance(test, SchemeSymbol) and test.name == 'else':
            if not is_last:
                raise SchemeError("else must be last clause")
            # Evaluate body
            body_list = list_to_pylist(body)
            for j, b in enumerate(body_list[:-1]):
                eval_form(b, env, tail=False)
            return eval_form(body_list[-1], env, tail=tail)
        else:
            test_val = eval_form(test, env, tail=False)
            if test_val is not False:
                body_list = list_to_pylist(body)
                if not body_list:
                    return test_val
                for j, b in enumerate(body_list[:-1]):
                    eval_form(b, env, tail=False)
                return eval_form(body_list[-1], env, tail=tail)
    return UNSPECIFIED

def _eval_and(form, env, tail):
    # (and e ...)
    rest = form.cdr
    exprs = list_to_pylist(rest)
    for i, expr in enumerate(exprs):
        is_last = (i == len(exprs) - 1)
        val = eval_form(expr, env, tail=(tail and is_last))
        if isinstance(val, TailCall):
            return val
        if val is False:
            return False
    return True

def _eval_or(form, env, tail):
    # (or e ...)
    rest = form.cdr
    exprs = list_to_pylist(rest)
    for i, expr in enumerate(exprs):
        is_last = (i == len(exprs) - 1)
        val = eval_form(expr, env, tail=(tail and is_last))
        if isinstance(val, TailCall):
            return val
        if val is not False:
            return val
    return False

def _eval_let(form, env, tail):
    # (let ((v init) ...) body...) or (let name ((v init) ...) body...)
    rest = form.cdr
    if rest is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed let")
    first = rest.car
    
    if isinstance(first, SchemeSymbol):
        # Named let: (let name ((v init) ...) body...)
        name = first
        rest2 = rest.cdr
        if rest2 is SCHEME_EMPTY:
            raise SchemeError("malformed named let")
        bindings_list = rest2.car
        rest3 = rest2.cdr
        if rest3 is SCHEME_EMPTY:
            raise SchemeError("malformed named let: missing body")
        body = rest3
        # Parse bindings
        bindings = _parse_bindings(bindings_list)
        return _eval_named_let(name, bindings, body, env, tail)
    else:
        # Regular let: (let ((v init) ...) body...)
        bindings_list = first
        rest2 = rest.cdr
        if rest2 is SCHEME_EMPTY:
            raise SchemeError("malformed let: missing body")
        body = rest2
        bindings = _parse_bindings(bindings_list)
        return _eval_let_regular(bindings, body, env, tail)

def _parse_bindings(bindings_list):
    """Parse ((v init) ...) into list of (SchemeSymbol, form)."""
    if bindings_list is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        return []
    if not isinstance(bindings_list, SchemePair) or not is_proper_list(bindings_list):
        raise SchemeError("malformed bindings")
    result = []
    x = bindings_list
    while x is not SCHEME_EMPTY:
        binding = x.car
        if not isinstance(binding, SchemePair) or not is_proper_list(binding):
            raise SchemeError("malformed binding")
        if binding.cdr is SCHEME_EMPTY or binding.cdr.cdr is not SCHEME_EMPTY:
            raise SchemeError("malformed binding")
        var = binding.car
        init = binding.cdr.car
        if not isinstance(var, SchemeSymbol):
            raise SchemeError("binding variable must be a symbol")
        result.append((var, init))
        x = x.cdr
    return result

def _eval_let_regular(bindings, body, env, tail):
    # Evaluate all inits in outer scope
    vals = []
    for var, init in bindings:
        val = eval_form(init, env, tail=False)
        vals.append(val)
    # Create new env
    new_env = Environment(env)
    for (var, _), val in zip(bindings, vals):
        new_env.vars[var.name] = val
    # Evaluate body
    body_list = list_to_pylist(body)
    if not body_list:
        raise SchemeError("empty body")
    return _eval_body(body_list, new_env, tail)

def _eval_let_star(form, env, tail):
    rest = form.cdr
    if rest is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed let*")
    bindings_list = rest.car
    body = rest.cdr
    if body is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed let*: missing body")
    bindings = _parse_bindings(bindings_list)
    new_env = Environment(env)
    for var, init in bindings:
        val = eval_form(init, new_env, tail=False)
        new_env.vars[var.name] = val
    body_list = list_to_pylist(body)
    if not body_list:
        raise SchemeError("empty body")
    return _eval_body(body_list, new_env, tail)

def _eval_letrec(form, env, tail):
    rest = form.cdr
    if rest is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed letrec")
    bindings_list = rest.car
    body = rest.cdr
    if body is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed letrec: missing body")
    bindings = _parse_bindings(bindings_list)
    new_env = Environment(env)
    for var, _ in bindings:
        new_env.vars[var.name] = UNINITIALIZED
    for var, init in bindings:
        val = eval_form(init, new_env, tail=False)
        new_env.vars[var.name] = val
    body_list = list_to_pylist(body)
    if not body_list:
        raise SchemeError("empty body")
    return _eval_body(body_list, new_env, tail)

def _eval_named_let(name, bindings, body, env, tail):
    # Evaluate inits in outer scope
    vals = []
    for var, init in bindings:
        val = eval_form(init, env, tail=False)
        vals.append(val)
    var_names = [var for var, _ in bindings]
    
    # Create closure
    letrec_env = Environment(env)
    formals = ('fixed', var_names)
    body_list = list_to_pylist(body)
    closure = SchemeClosure(formals, body_list, letrec_env)
    letrec_env.vars[name.name] = closure
    
    # Call the closure
    if tail:
        new_env = Environment(closure.env)
        _bind_params(new_env, closure.formals, vals)
        return TailCall(EvalBody(closure.body, new_env), None)
    else:
        return _call_closure(closure, vals)

def _eval_lambda(form, env, tail):
    # (lambda formals body...)
    rest = form.cdr
    if rest is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed lambda")
    formals_datum = rest.car
    body = rest.cdr
    if body is SCHEME_EMPTY:
        raise SchemeError("malformed lambda: empty body")
    formals = _parse_formals(formals_datum)
    body_list = list_to_pylist(body)
    return SchemeClosure(formals, body_list, env)
